metrics.label: Market Cap
metrics.description: Total market value of all outstanding shares (Price × Shares).

metrics.label: Total Debt
metrics.description: Sum of short-term and long-term interest-bearing debt.

metrics.label: Cash & Inv.
metrics.description: Cash & Investments: Cash, equivalents, and short-term investments available on the balance sheet.

metrics.label: Enterprise Value
metrics.description: Total company value: Market Cap + Debt − Cash.

metrics.label: Expense Ratio
metrics.description: Annual fee charged to investors, expressed as % of assets

metrics.label: 30 Day Yield
metrics.description: Income earned over the past 30 days, annualized

metrics.label: Dividend Yield
metrics.description: Annual dividends as a percentage of the ETF price

metrics.label: P/E Ratio
metrics.description: Weighted average price-to-earnings ratio of the underlying holdings
